name: תִּבְנִי
summary: Tibni son of Ginath is Omri’s rival for the throne. Part of Israel supports him until Omri’s followers prevail.

evidence.note: One part of the people wants to make Tibni king.

note: The proposed colour sense takes the name as an adjective from תֶּבֶן. The narrative supplies no explanation. Krahmalkov compares Phoenician TBNT under that personal name and leaves its meaning open.
